title: Puducherry Chief Minister's Comprehensive Health Insurance Scheme Policy Document

nodes.title: 1. Overview & Objectives
nodes.content: Government health protection arrangement for eligible Puducherry residents for specified hospitalization services.

nodes.title: 2. Eligibility Criteria
nodes.content: Eligibility depends on current Puducherry residency, beneficiary category and scheme enrolment rules.

nodes.title: 3. Benefits & Coverage
nodes.content: Financial assistance and healthcare benefits provided under Puducherry Chief Minister's Comprehensive Health Insurance Scheme.

nodes.title: 4. Required Documents & Application Process
nodes.content: Aadhaar Card, Income Certificate, Ration Card, and Bank Account details.
